newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-W.P. 235-4 AT CLOSE AGAINST FREE STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-W.P. 235-4 AT CLOSE AGAINST FREE STATE.

text.p: An unbeaten 118 from Jacques Kallis put Western Province in a strong position at 235 for four at the close on the opening day of their four-day match against Free State at Springbok Park on Friday.
Province's gamble of picking only four specialist batsmen appears to have paid off as Sven Koenig and Kallis put on 117 for the second wicket on a friendly batting track.

Despite the Free State side being bolstered by the late inclusion of all-rounder Herman Bakkes, the bowling line-up looked flat without international players Allan Donald and Nicky Boje and discarded Chris Craven.
Bowling: Stephenson 12-5-19-1, Cilliers 5-0-21-1, Player 11-2-36-0, Bakkes 17-5-50-0, Botha 13-3-48-1, Venter 26-11-52-1
Bonus points: Western Province 2, Free State 1.
